title: FLA import: AS2 frame scripts display as one line — Windows CRLF not normalized
description: Fixed in readTimelineSubObject (packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts) by normalizing CRLF and bare CR to LF immediately after readCString returns the raw script text. The mx2004-frame-scripts.fla fixture was confirmed to contain real CRLF sequences in its UTF-16LE BomString script fields. New test in flash8-import.test.ts asserts no CR chars remain after import. All 4946 tests pass. Commit: ed4cab5
